title: Virtual Stream Deck Classic
brief: Web page that shows a virtual Stream Deck Classic on phones (landscape) and browsers after a password, plus the app-side header menu flag with address, QR, certificate fingerprint, password, port and viewers list.

artboards.title: Web · Device replica
artboards.tradeoff: Looks like the real Classic; chassis costs space, keys ~86 px on a phone

artboards.title: Web · Keys first
artboards.tradeoff: Largest touch targets (~112 px); loses the real-device look, chrome behind a menu button

artboards.title: Web · Status rail
artboards.tradeoff: Shows profile, page and leave on screen; keys shrink to ~72 px

artboards.title: App · All in the menu
artboards.tradeoff: One place, no extra window; the menu grows to ~700 px while on

artboards.title: App · Menu switch and settings dialog
artboards.tradeoff: Short menu and roomy dialog with Disconnect all; one more click
